job.title: Java Developer | SAP Commerce (m/w/d)
job.email_subject: Application: Java Developer | SAP Commerce – Kranti Chavan
job.email_body:
Dear Annika Jürs,

You need a Java developer who is productive on SAP Commerce from day one – I have built and extended SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) with Java and Spring at Rockwell Automation and Shell for 5+ years.

– OCC REST APIs for headless storefronts and PWA frontends
– Promotions Engine, OMS, Cronjobs, Impex and Backoffice
– SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer

I work independently and results-driven in international, agile teams – remote, hybrid or on-site. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. My CV and cover letter are attached. I would be glad to show you in a short call what I can deliver for hmmh.

Kind regards
Kranti Chavan

tailoring.headline: Java Developer | SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) | Spring, OCC REST APIs | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Java developer with 5+ years building and extending enterprise SAP Commerce Cloud platforms (Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, OCC REST web services for headless storefronts and PWA frontends, and PIM / ERP / MDM integrations. Developed Promotions Engine, Order Management (OMS), Cronjobs, Impex and Backoffice customizations; tuned SQL and FlexibleSearch performance. Performs code reviews, mentors junior developers and executes CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2 in agile teams. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

tailoring.why_company: hmmh combines strategy, design and technology in long-standing SAP Commerce projects for strong brands. As an agency team, you need developers who deliver reliable platform work for many clients – exactly what I have done on large B2B and B2C platforms. Your remote-friendly setup and focus on modern commerce make hmmh my first choice.

en.subject: Application: Java Developer | SAP Commerce
en.hook: hmmh builds SAP Commerce solutions for well-known brands, and you need a Java developer who is productive on the platform from day one. That is my daily work for more than five years: at Rockwell Automation and Shell I build and extend SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 and 2211) with Java and Spring, from OCC APIs to complex integrations – as an SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

bullets.label: Java & SAP Commerce development
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend and frontend functionality for product, catalog, pricing and customer data on Hybris 2211 with Java and Spring, following platform best practices and design patterns.

bullets.label: Headless & APIs
bullets.text: Developed OCC REST web services for storefronts, PWA frontends and third-party consumers; customized Interceptors, Populators and Converters for custom data flows.

bullets.label: Core platform modules
bullets.text: Developed and maintained the Promotions Engine, Order Management (OMS), FlexibleSearch queries, Cronjobs, Impex scripts and Backoffice components.

bullets.label: Quality & delivery
bullets.text: Code reviews and technical guidance for junior developers, query refactoring for faster response times and CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2).
